claim_rule.criteria_1_to_3_pass_only: Physical error law supported; production gating induces selection or reporting limits.
claim_rule.otherwise: Fresh holdout did not provide stronger evidence. Publish unchanged and do not rerun.

design.outer_noise: Independent isotropic Gaussian draws in each LOS tangent plane, mapped by the spherical exponential map; domain-separated by sensor, cell, replicate, and phase master seed.

development.use: Harness verification and frozen prediction coefficients only; never confirmatory evidence.

forbidden_after_holdout: solver or README changes based on a failed holdout

prediction_comparison.evaluation: Evaluate both frozen models on all holdout worlds.
prediction_comparison.metric: relative RMSE improvement=(block-only RMSE-full RMSE)/block-only RMSE
prediction_comparison.training: Freeze full and block-only OLS coefficients from the 2160-world development set.
prediction_comparison.uncertainty: Same 10000 noise-stratified whole-cell holdout bootstrap with development coefficients fixed.

primary_analysis.block_coding: Treatment indicators; first declared level is reference.
primary_analysis.bootstrap: Exactly 10000 noise-stratified whole-cell pairs resamples using Python random.Random MT19937; 135 cells sampled with replacement inside each of four noise strata; type-7 linear 2.5% and 97.5% quantiles.
primary_analysis.model: OLS Y=intercept+beta*X+fixed block effects for range, frame count, and orientation family
primary_analysis.outcome: Y=log(unrounded 3D position error / true sensor1 range)
primary_analysis.population: All 6480 generated positive-noise holdout worlds using an ungated, unrounded center-frame closest-approach midpoint.
primary_analysis.robust_ci: Bell-McCaffrey CR2 by 540 factorial cells, A_g=(I-X_g(X'X)^-1X_g')^-1/2, Student-t reference df=clusters-rank.

purpose: One untouched confirmation of a physics-based crossing-angle error law without optimizing correlation or changing the production solver.
reporting: complete row-level JSON and scalar CSV
CR2 coefficients, standard errors, confidence intervals, and design columns
bootstrap seed, count, method, and intervals
all six gates as PASS or FAIL

success_criteria.1: CR2 95% CI for beta wholly above zero.
success_criteria.2: CR2 90% CI for beta wholly within [0.75,1.25].
success_criteria.3: Frozen-development full model improves holdout log-error RMSE by at least 10%, with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound above zero.
success_criteria.4: Solve status and reason reported for all 6480 holdout worlds.
success_criteria.5: Production solvability at least 90% overall, at least 80% in every cell, and absolute solved-only versus all-world beta difference no more than 0.15.
success_criteria.6: X-by-frame and X-by-orientation secondary interactions always reported with Holm-adjusted p-values.
